whole_result: For every variable set S, S is a stopping set iff S=supp(x) for some x in P(H). P supports cannot leave one positive neighbor at a check; each stopping indicator is in K and a small positive rescaling lies in P. Empty S is realized by zero. This characterizes support and does not assert 1_S itself is in P or recover amplitudes.
explanation: For x in P subset K, a check with unique positive neighbor i violates x_i<=sum(other neighbors)=0. Conversely v=1_S satisfies every cone inequality: left side is0 outside S and, for i in S, another S-neighbor makes right side>=1. For nonempty S choose alpha>0 with alpha v in P; its support remains S. For empty S choose x=0. Same-support vectors (1,1,1) and (2,1,1) for H=(1,1,1) also show support need not fix AWGN/BSC weight after rescaling into P.
scope: Whole target theorem for every finite binary H; no reverse reconstruction of the entire cone or trapping-set dynamics.
